I recently started using Afforai as my go-to AI research tool, and it has been a game changer. With its support for various data formats like PDF, Word, and web pages, I can easily gather information from multiple sources in one place. The best part is that the sources from which the output is generated are pinpointed in the documents. Its integration with the Azure version of GPT not only ensures stability but also prioritizes privacy, which is a huge plus for me. Overall, Afforai has definitely saved me a lot of time while learning and researching by efficiently providing me with comprehensive insights. I can fully recommend the tool!
